remarks: Welcome to luxury living in the heart of downtown Stamford! This stunning one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo has been beautifully repainted and refreshed to like-new condition, offering the perfect blend of comfort and style. Sleek wood floors throughout. This apartment is move-in ready for its new owner. Storage is never an issue with this unit, as it boasts five large closets, including two in the oversized bedroom. You'll have plenty of space to keep your home organized and clutter-free. One of the biggest perks is the comprehensive HOA package, which includes grounds maintenance, snow removal, heat, hot water, property management, and insurance-covering everything except electricity. This makes budgeting for your home both simple and cost-effective. The building has a range of amenities, including a fitness center, updated laundry facilities, and beautifully landscaped common areas. The highly responsive superintendent staff ensures a hassle-free living experience. Step outside to enjoy your private balcony, ideal for morning coffee or taking in the lively atmosphere of Stamford's downtown, including parades along Summer Street. This prime location has unbeatable convenience, a short walk to Metro North, public transportation, Stamford's best restaurants, bars, and UConn's campus. The unit also includes a dedicated parking space, ensuring effortless city living. Don't miss your chance to own a beautiful unit in one of downtown Stamford's most desirable locations!
